scope: Exploratory comparison of a homogeneous gray thermal absorber/emitter with constant fractional photon-energy conversion. Reuses all 43 exposed FIRAS channels; no blind validation or official confidence limits.
fit: Profile thermalizer temperature and signed recovered Galaxy template coefficient; fixed absolute spectral normalization. Include unchanged Planck comparator. No extra instrumental gain, full covariance or calibration likelihood.
integration: 128-point Gauss-Laguerre for exp(-y) weighted stationary characteristic solution, checked against adaptive quadrature and 256 points.
assumptions: fixed physical volume and light speed
frequency-independent true absorption with LTE thermal emission at fixed material temperature
homogeneous isotropic bath without boundary escape
external heating budget explicitly required but source not derived
